messages:
anya: Heads-up — we need model-specific quotas for gen/embedding families. Current per-org quotas are blowing up the small models when customers switch to large-family.

sam: Agreed. Seen cases where embeddings-xxl consumes same quota as embeddings-base. We should weight by model family.

liam: Proposal: keep hierarchy -> per-key override > per-org per-model-family > global default. Implement as weight multipliers (cost per token) so we reuse existing token accounting.

sam: +1. Also need burst controls: token-bucket per (org, model_family) with refill rate = allowed_tokens_per_sec and max_burst = burst_multiplier * refill_capacity.

anya: UX ask: console needs a compact table for each org showing family, limit (tokens/min), current usage, burst allowance, and a temporary override control with TTL. Show estimated $ cost impact next to each row.

liam: Telemetry note: emit `quota.enforcement.event` for every enforcement decision with org_id, key_id, model_family, action (allow|throttle|reject), reason, and token_cost. Keep payload small to avoid high cardinality.

sam: For API behavior: inline check in router prior to scheduling. If throttled return 429 + headers: `X-Quota-Remaining`, `X-Quota-Burst-Remaining`, `Retry-After`.

anya: Edge case: batched calls touching multiple model families in one request. Do we charge against the heaviest model or split? I prefer proportional split by requested tokens per model.

liam: Config example (proto/json sketch):
```
quota: {
  default_per_minute: 60000,
  model_family_weights: {"gpt-4": 10, "gpt-3.5": 1, "embed-xxl": 5, "embed-base": 1},
  burst_multiplier: 2
}
```
This keeps enforcement as multiplier * tokens so existing counters work.

sam: Ops checklist: migration path for current orgs, safe defaults (no sudden drops), and canary rollout. We'll expose a feature-flag to toggle by org.

anya: Product plan: communicate changes in-console and via email to affected customers, include migration guide and default equivalence table.

devops-bot: Deployment scheduled: quota-enforcer:v1 -> canary on infra-44 at 2024-06-22T15:30Z :robot_face:

liam: I'll draft the enforcement spec + API proto changes and link it here.

sam: I'll wire the console rows and make the override flow. Also will add `quota.alerts` when usage > 90% of family limit.

anya: thanks — sync tomorrow 10am to review PRs. @liam @sam :thumbsup:
